EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Woohoo, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I love it! You like to chitchat

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}You're getting me worried! There's
gotta be something wrong if you
keep wanting to talk, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Vale, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}me estás preocupando! 
Que quieras hablar tanto conmigo
roza lo paranormal. ¿Qué te pasa?

{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Mi preoccupi! Deve esserci
qualcosa che non va se continui
a rivolgermi la parola, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.

{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Du machst mir langsam Angst,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Da kann doch was nicht stimmen,
wenn du immer noch quatschen

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}What is it? Seems like you've really
got something on your mind,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

decirme, ¡no te cortes, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ne fais pas cette tête-là, dis.

{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Che c'è? Sembra che ci sia

{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
